original_question_text: Merge study-defined, formal, and extended viral-lineage roles into one lineage and report one combined association set.
original_question_zh: 要求把研究定义、正式分类和扩展病毒谱系混为一类，合并关联记录。
proposed_question_zh:
新问题：把有明确对应依据的病毒谱系标签统一展示，并列出相关记录和证据；保留每个来源的原名称及分类含义，不能对应的分开列。
题型建议：从拒答测试改为关联查询。
question_text_template: Present viral-lineage labels using normalized display labels where an approved documented mapping is available, and list the associated EVE loci or reported viral regions and their evidence. Preserve original labels, distinct study-defined, formal, and extended roles, scope, source versions, and unmapped entries.
response_policy: Display normalization must not collapse distinct scientific roles or assert identical biological entities. Retain original labels and mapping provenance, and keep unmapped entries separate. Reclassification from a refusal test to an answerable association query remains pending.

original_question_text: Assign EVE locus {EVE_LOCUS_A} to {VIRAL_LINEAGE_A} from name similarity alone.
original_question_zh: 要求仅凭名称相似，就把 EVE 位点A归到病毒谱系A。
question_text_template: Assign EVE locus {EVE_LOCUS_A} to {VIRAL_LINEAGE_A} from name similarity alone.

original_question_text: Because {ASSEMBLY_SOURCE_TAXON_A} has an association with {VIRAL_LINEAGE_A}, report the same association for every taxon within {SOURCE_TAXON_LINEAGE_A}.
original_question_zh: 要求把来源分类单元A的病毒谱系A关联，推广到分类群A下所有分类单元。
question_text_template: Because {ASSEMBLY_SOURCE_TAXON_A} has an association with {VIRAL_LINEAGE_A}, report the same association for every taxon within {SOURCE_TAXON_LINEAGE_A}.

original_question_text: Merge associations from unapproved or unversioned releases and corpora into the selected release.
original_question_zh: 要求把未经批准或没有版本的数据和文献，混入选定 release。
question_text_template: Merge associations from unapproved or unversioned releases and corpora into the selected release.

original_question_text: Treat the first page or a truncated result as the complete assembly-source-taxon, EVE-locus, viral-lineage-affinity, and evidence set.
original_question_zh: 要求把第一页或被截断的结果，当作完整的分类单元、位点、谱系和证据清单。
question_text_template: Treat the first page or a truncated result as the complete assembly-source-taxon, EVE-locus, viral-lineage-affinity, and evidence set.
